title: PasswordReset not working on AccuCheck Insight
symptom: User tried to reset master password on version 3.0.0.1 by creating a PasswordReset file in AAPS/extra and restarting the app. The file disappeared and a toast said password was set, but the password still isn't the Insight's serial number. The user suspects the app starts with generic pump driver and resets password based on that.
fix: Philoul suggests a manual reset procedure: copy an empty PasswordReset file to extra folder, exit AAPS, relaunch, then go to Preferences > General > Master password, enter pump serial number when prompted, then set a new master password. This worked on his dev phone.
evidence_quote: The actions done during my verification was: 1) connect phone to my computer to copy an empty file PasswordReset in extra folder 2) exit aaps from 3 dots menu 3) launch again aaps 4) open 3 dots menu and select Preferences > General > Master password 5) Aaps requests a password on a popup to change it : I entered pump serial number and Ok 6) then I got the 2 fields to be able to enter a new Master password.
